governing_invariants: Classification changes routing and lineage only; it does not move, rewrite, normalize, or delete source evidence.
Original source bytes remain authoritative in their owning source stores.
A repository classification does not verify the truth of factual or legal claims contained in that repository.
VERIFIED family roles require direct controlling repository evidence; weaker evidence remains explicitly unresolved or non-VERIFIED.
Derived OCR, transcription, summaries, matrices, and generated work product never become original evidence by storage or repetition.
